description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notification made by the Director General of Customs in terms of Section 51 of the Customs Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under Section 51 of the Customs Ordinance, introducing a new Value Declaration Form and establishing regulatory requirements for import declarations. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs procedures, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
